# Workouse — Elite Fullstack Engineering for Scale

> Workouse is a boutique, solo software development house building resilient, high-scale web applications for forward-thinking companies in Europe and the US. Engineered by Emre Yılmaz, a senior software architect with 15+ years of experience.

## Core Products & Tools

- Site Audit Engine: Automated website performance, security vulnerability, and SEO health scanner with itemized repair cost estimation based on a flat $35/hr rate (https://workouse.com/#audit).
- 100m Social Room: Location-verified social networking for physical venues via GPS/QR check-ins with privacy protection (https://100m.workouse.com).
- Bilo Bunker: Stateful, multi-tenant Nostr remote signing service (NIP-46) securing Nostr private keys on server infrastructure (https://github.com/workouse/bilo-bunker).
- Zero-DB QR Menu: Sub-100ms restaurant menu compiler serving static menus straight from edge nodes, bypassing database latency (https://qr-menu.workouse.com).
- Dede Korkut AI: AI-powered demo video generator creating interactive walkthrough videos with narration and camera zoom from UI features (https://dedekorkut.workouse.com).
- NostrBridge: Webhook Relay Engine bridging HTTP webhooks (GitHub, Stripe, RSS) to Nostr relays with NIP-98 auth, NIP-57 Zaps, and Liquid templates (https://bridge.workouse.com).
- AI Curated News: Autonomous AI news aggregator on Cloudflare Workers AI & Vectorize, scoring tech news (HN, Lobsters, Reddit) against Nostr upvotes (https://news.emre.xyz).
- x2nostr: Universal client-side data migration platform from centralized services (Goodreads, Blogs, IMDb, Letterboxd, Twitter, Spotify) to Nostr (https://x2nostr.emre.xyz).

## Services

- Fullstack Architecture: End-to-end applications using modern frameworks, robust APIs, and resilient distributed systems.
- Automated Site Audits: Instant technical health scanning covering Core Web Vitals, security vulnerabilities, SEO, and remediation estimates.
- DevOps & Automation: CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), container orchestration, and developer velocity.
- Performance Engineering: Algorithm optimisation, latency reduction, and sub-millisecond critical path engineering.
